cases.name: kotlin: clauses, lists and conditions
cases.output:
SELECT
    u.id,
    u.name,
    count(*) AS orders
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = TRUE
    AND o.total >= 10
    OR u.vip
GROUP BY
    u.id,
    u.name
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 10

cases.name: kotlin: single items stay on the clause line
kotlin: subqueries, calls and IN lists
cases.output:

FROM users

    FROM orders

)
    AND status IN ('a', 'b')

cases.name: union, joins and offsets
cases.output:
SELECT a
FROM t
UNION ALL
SELECT b
FROM u
INNER JOIN v ON u.id = v.id
    AND v.x > 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 5
OFFSET 10

cases.name: cte with nested subquery
cases.output:
WITH RECURSIVE r AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION
    SELECT n + 1
    FROM r
    WHERE n < 3
)
SELECT *
FROM r
WHERE x IN (
    WITH q AS (
        SELECT 2
    )
    SELECT *
    FROM q
)
